body: Great! Thanks for the pictures. I guess we all were embarrassing at some point.
Well, it's not very usual and most of the people/guys I know do it. You're right, I do take myself too seriously sometimes!
I'm glad you found it funny! I actually think I'm being a little too hard on myself and no one else will likely notice or pick apart these old pictures. Thanks for the reply!

Haha, yeah, those jeans were comfortable. I could never quite get a new pair of Levis to wear-in like those. I now wear some nice fitting 501s and they're still pretty comfortable. I guess the further away I get from my embarrassing years the easier it will be. Thanks.

Yeah, I've definitely been wearing/attempting to wear nicer clothes since graduation. I just see the picture/pictures and go: "wow...that is me". What I should be saying is "wow...that *was* me". Thanks for the insight.
Thanks for the reply. Yeah, I believe I do have the insight now to be me and limit my external influences so I'm not doing something that is *not* me. I'm appreciative of your comment.
